name: Piano
instruction: Design a 3D model of a grand piano. The body should be large and curved, with a lid that can be opened. Add a keyboard with black and white keys. Include three pedals at the bottom.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a grand piano.
The body of the piano is large and curved.
The lid of the piano is designed to be opened.
The keyboard is rectangular and positioned horizontally.
Color representation: The piano body is typically represented in a polished black or wood finish.
The keys are accurately depicted in black and white.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The keyboard is proportionate to the body
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The lid is correctly positioned to open without obstruction.
The keyboard is properly aligned with the body of the piano.
The pedals are placed at the base and are accessible.
Object distance and contact: The keyboard does not overlap with the body.
The pedals are positioned directly beneath the keyboard.
The lid opens without interfering with the keyboard.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
The design adheres closely to the provided instructions.
